name: Orc Warrior — V4 retouch Aseprite sobre V2

appearance.face: Concept-07 escolhido e aprovado pelo criador em 2026-10-19: Orc adulto de feição bestial e brutal, testa pesada, focinho/nariz largo e achatado, maxilar anguloso, olhos ferozes e presas inferiores grandes e irregulares; expressão tensa, agressiva e battle-hardened, sem serenidade humana. Identidade deste indivíduo; não universalizar como cânone de todos os Orcs.
appearance.hair: Careca, couro cabeludo totalmente nu; preservar sobrancelhas escuras, conforme concept-07 escolhido pelo criador em 2026-10-19.
appearance.body: Compacto, ombros largos e musculatura robusta, com proporção tática legível dentro do perfil de 1 tile; não copiar o corpo humanoide do piloto.
asymmetries: mão dominante direita, vazia no conceito base
appearance.lighting: Proposta de luz superior esquerda, com clusters e contraste alinhados à âncora; direção ainda candidata.

outfit.description: Proposta candidata: proteção de ferro escuro e couro, faixa curta vermelho queimado e um ombro reforçado. Conceito/base sem armas, escudo ou capa; ainda sem receita visual aprovada.
outfit.weapon: Possível machado de batalha de uma mão como asset independente, ainda não criado; aparece somente equipado e invocado por ação.

profile.note: Baseline do piloto humanoide 1 tile; anatomias diferentes exigem perfil e revisao. Walk atual usa 3 quadros/tile.

reuseAssessment.component: Identity, anatomy, outfit and approved source pixels
reuseAssessment.evidence: V2 concept approval and creator-approval-v2.json hashes
reuseAssessment.adaptation: Fork native V2 .aseprite sources; import the original V2 concept into Aseprite without rescaling.
reuseAssessment.artRisk: Maintain individual identity and approved shading; no new anatomy.
reuseAssessment.technicalRisk: Verify preserved reference cels and original source hashes.
reuseAssessment.productionImpact: Existing design retained; no baseline overwrite.

reuseAssessment.evidence: V2 Attack first approved frame; final Attack/Hit were inspected and differ from it.
reuseAssessment.adaptation: Use the approved neutral pose as the final frame of both candidate actions; retain count and durations.
reuseAssessment.artRisk: Could make recovery feel more abrupt; creator must evaluate in motion.
reuseAssessment.technicalRisk: Silhouette changes limited to the two return frames, no scaling/mirroring.
reuseAssessment.productionImpact: Two candidate return frames; no runtime apply.

reuseAssessment.evidence: V2 per-pose visual inspection and explicit coordinate patches in retouch-v2-to-v4.lua
reuseAssessment.adaptation: Warm iris using existing colors, local shadow/highlight pixels, consolidate near-identical ink colors.
reuseAssessment.artRisk: Small changes, not a new design or guaranteed improvement.
reuseAssessment.technicalRisk: No unintended alpha changes outside declared return/fringe cleanup.

reuseAssessment.adaptation: Separate task after art approval; these layers do not constitute a body/equipment rig.
reuseAssessment.technicalRisk: No weapons, events, bindings or variable-duration playback implemented.

revisionIntent.reference: Approved V2 concept and Attack/Hit frames
revisionIntent.scope: Preserve approved face/anatomy/outfit; local pixel retouch, near-black cleanup and shared neutral return.
revisionIntent.concept: Same1254 resolution, original face/body untouched; low-alpha noise cleanup and six rivet pixels.
revisionIntent.artworkLineage: V2 historical image_gen origin preserved; new edits inside Aseprite only.
